digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud <-> Data Center adapter reconciler
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) has mature byte-for-byte characterization pins and large test corpus from production incidents, while Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) has newer operational-edge coverage (pagination, rate limiting, TLS) but lacks value pinning on field sanitization and comment/description convergence
Data Center adapter's whole-project readers have never been tested beyond one page, creating a single highest-risk gap in production coverage
Ticket-type map is duplicated within adapters/ codebase and must be single-sourced before being guarded by regression tests
DC comment and description ceiling values and convergence behavior across multiple passes are not pinned by value, only by shape in contract tests
Five enumerated vacuous tests in the suite assert only contract shape rather than actual behavior or decision rationale, creating false confidence in coverage
